RAAF Richmond Airshow on Saturday and Sunday. Gates will open at 9am, with flying displays to be conducted from 11am to 4pm each day.

With up to 40,000 attendees expected each day over the weekend, heavy traffic is expected in Clarendon and surrounding suburbs approaching the airbase.

Motorists should allow extra travel time on roads including Hawkesbury Valley Way, Blacktown Rd, The Northern Rd and Richmond Rd.

Limited paid-parking will be available at Hawkesbury Showground (pre-purchased ticket required). Access to showground parking will be via Blacktown Rd only not Hawkesbury Valley Way due to the partial closure of Racecourse Rd for the event.

Road closures

  • Racecourse Rd will be closed at Hawkesbury Valley Way and the Rail line crossing from 6am to 6pm on Saturday and Sunday for the safety of crowds getting to and from the event via the train station.
  • Sections of Hobart St and Percival St surrounding the airbase will also be closed between 6.30am and 5pm each day.

Special event clearway parking restrictions will be in effect on Hawkesbury Valley Way, Dight St and Hobart St surrounding the airbase from 7am to 6pm each day.

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.

Traffic will be very heavy on approaches to Bondi including Bondi Rd, Syd Einfeld Dr, Old South Head Rd and Military Rd as well as local roads around Bondi Beach. Motorists are advised to avoid non-essential travel or allow plenty of extra travel time. Some rounds around Bondi Junction Interchange will be closed between 10am and 4pm.

Special event clearways are in effect from 7am to 7pm on both sides of Bondi Rd between Old South Head Rd and Sandridge St, as well as sections of Campbell Pde and Hall St.

Thousands of cyclists will take part in either the 50km or the 10km ride for Spring Cycle from North Sydney to Olympic Park via Pyrmont. Road closures will be in place along the first 10km to Pyrmont, from there cyclists will continue on to Olympic Park sharing roads with motorists and abiding by general road rules.

ROAD CLOSURES - 4AM TO 11:30AM:

- Cahill Expressway Lanes 7 & 8 and Circular Quay Overpass and Sydney Harbour Bridge Lanes 3 and 6: two lanes on the Harbour Bridge remain open in each direction under a reduced 40km/h speed limit. 

- North Sydney: Miller St from Falcon St to Pacific Hwy , Berry St from Pacific Hwy to Walker St, sections of Arthur St, Carlow St, Blue St and surrounding local roads including the High St bridge on-ramp.

- Sydney CBD: Hickson Rd / Sussex St from Towns Place to King St and sections of Argyle St, Dalgety Rd and Upper Fort St.

- Western Distributor from Pyrmont to the City including Pyrmont on-ramp, Fig St on-ramp and King St off- ramp. Citybound motorists from the Anzac Bridge will be diverted via the Bathurst St off-ramp to re-join the Harbour Bridge or access City North via Harbour St or Kent St.

- Pyrmont: Pyrmont St, Pyrmont Bridge Rd, Union St, Murray St and surrounding local roads. Pirrrama Rd remains closed until 11.30am.

Some closures will be in place around Sydney Olympic Park between 7:30am and 3pm including sections of Hill Rd, Edwin Flack Ave and Olympic Blvd.

Special event clearways will be in place on roads along sections of the course in North Sydney, Millers Point and Pyrmont between 3am and 11am and in Five Dock/Concord between 5am and 11am.

Clearways are strict no-parking zones and apply even for local residents and RMS Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies.

Road closures and special event clearways will be in place in the Sydney CBD on Friday 12 September for a Police Operation.

Roads in the Sydney CBD will close from 10am to safely facilitate the event. Roads will progressively reopen behind the parade, with all closures lifted by 11.30am.

  • From 10am to 11.30am: Macquarie Street will be closed between St James Road and Albert Street, along with sections of Hunter Street and Phillip Lane.
  • From 10.30am to 11.30am: Cahill Expressway on and off ramps at Macquarie Street will be closed, along with Conservatorium Road and sections of Bridge Street, Bent Street and Shakespeare Place.
  • From 10.45am to 11.30am: Macquarie Street between Albert Street and Sydney Opera House roundabout, and Albert Street will be closed. Vehicle exit from Albert Street car park will be maintained westbound to Phillip Street.

Special event clearway parking restrictions will be in effect on both sides of Macquarie Street from 7.30am to 11.30am, between St James Road and the Sydney Opera House roundabout.

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.

Cirque du Soleil: Corteo at Qudos Bank Arena from Thursday 4 until Sunday 14 September. Multiple shows daily on Thursday through to Sunday each week.

Significant traffic delays are expected on roads approaching the precinct for Thursday and Friday performances as attendees travel in the busy evening peak, and across the weekends while multiple other events take place at nearby venues. Motorists should allow extra travel time on the M4 Mwy, Homebush Bay Dr, Concord Rd, Lane Cove Rd, Parramatta Rd, Centenary Dr and Silverwater Rd.

If you have to drive, carpool with your group pre-book your parking online ahead of time to secure a space – available until 11:59pm the night before the event unless sold out prior. If you have pre-booked your parking, follow the directions of staff and have your parking ticket ready to show at the car park entry.

Roads may be closed in the precinct, for closure details, visit the Sydney Olympic Park interactive map for more details.

Everest Carnival: Surf to Turf Day at Royal Randwick Racecourse on Saturday 20 September. First race at 11.50am, last race at 5.15pm.

Traffic may be heavier than usual on Anzac Pde, Doncaster Ave, High St, Alison Rd and Darley Rd as crowds travel to and from the event.

The right-turn bay into Randwick Racecourse gate 1 on Alison Road (eastbound) will be closed. 

Motorists should allow extra travel time and be aware of increased pedestrian activity on local roads.

Special Event Clearways 

Special event clearways will be in place at the following times and locations: 

  • 4am – 7pm: Darley Road between Alison Road and the Grand Drive roundabout (western side) 
  • 8am – 7pm: Ascot Street between Doncaster Avenue and the roundabout at the entry to Randwick Racecourse (both sides) 
  • 3pm – 7pm: High Street between Doncaster Avenue and the roundabout at the entry to Randwick Racecourse (southern sides) 

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types and apply even to local residents and Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.
